lines.text: m v² / (R + h) = G M m / (R + h)²

steps.why: Everything downstream depends on getting the radius right: it is measured from the CENTRE of the earth, not from the ground.
common_mistakes: Using h alone, or R alone, as the radius of the circular path.

recall.must_convey: That equating the gravitational pull to the centripetal force gives v equal to root G M by R plus h.
accept: root G M by R plus h
gravitational pull is the centripetal force
reject: T is 2 pi R plus h by v

steps.why: Squaring both sides gives T² ∝ (R + h)³ — Kepler’s third law following directly from Newton’s law of gravitation.

Calling T = 2π√((R + h)³ / GM) a cube-root form. It is a SQUARE root of (R + h) cubed; squaring both sides gives T² ∝ (R + h)³.
